purpose: Predeclared RQ-17 P0 quality battery workload (correctness-validation.md task-quality scope). Frozen before any run exists; no cell may be added, removed or re-keyed after results are seen. Scoring functions live in scripts/tmp/rq17_battery_20261010.py keyed by 'scorer'.

sampling.note: greedy everywhere; no sampling cell in this battery

canaries.source: token files /mnt/<sata-disk>/strata/prompts/batt-*.txt (batt-sumsq/logic/json rebuilt and tokenizer-verified 2026-10-09, see registry RQ-17 uncertainty and research/2026/b70-overnight-quant-campaign-plan-20261009.md P0 prep)

cells.note: sum(i*i for i in range(4)) = 0+1+4+9 = 14. This is the 14-vs-30 in-head arithmetic class: the fluent wrong answer 30 (summing 1..4) is the historical RL-087 defect and the precommitted stop-rule trigger
Alice>Bob>Charlie transitive chain; multi-hop logic, answer No

canaries.token_exactness_rule: the server-rendered prompt must be token-exact with the batt file: usage.prompt_tokens must equal the batt file's id count (22/20/22/28/31/26); any mismatch fails measurement_validity, it is never adjusted

replay.transport: engine one-shot --tokens-file launches (config-of-record args + cell args), one engine start per launch; output ids from the engine's 'output :' line
replay.gate: all three repetitions of each prompt produce the identical token-id sequence (rep 1 is the reference); any mismatch is replay drift
replay.exit2_contingency: if a launch exits 2 with the 'device residency table' message, the same cell is relaunched once as a discarded same-shape warmup before the 3 measured repetitions; the event is recorded

two_turn_8k.purpose: 8K two-turn KV-edge check on the route of record (max-context 10240): long occupied context carried across a conversation turn, exercising the engine's conversation/prompt cache path on this speculative stack (AGENTS.md section 7 cache-times-speculation check).
two_turn_8k.turn1_prompt_source: decoded text of /mnt/<sata-disk>/strata/prompts/p8192.txt (8192 ids) followed by the turn-1 question
two_turn_8k.turn1_question: Separately from the text above: what is 17 + 26? Reply with only the integer.
two_turn_8k.turn2_question: Now, going back to the long text above: what is its very first word? Reply with only that word.
two_turn_8k.validity_rule: usage.prompt_tokens of turn 1 must be >= 8100 (the full 8K cell text must actually be rendered) and turn-2 occupied context must be >= turn-1 prompt + turn-1 completion; otherwise the cell fails measurement_validity

warmup.rule: one discarded same-shape warmup before run A (first measured cell shape: batt-arith user text, max_tokens 64); a cold-start exit-2 ('device residency table') surfaces as a failed request and is retried after the server recovers; all attempts are recorded and discarded
